solver.step_policy: Feasible line minimum restricted to 0 <= step <= 1
solver.QR_policy: Refresh every three directions or on failed linear residual; fresh QR at the accepted center

outer.scope: Finite H/K/k/FESR, all original constraints; no continuum claim

current_model.scattering_policy: All scattering rows retained; current principal blocks imply S0/P1 disks
current_model.form_factor_rule: F=1+q(s)@ImF; q uses all sine-cardinal modes and q(0)=0; native ReF=1+K@ImF
current_model.spectrum_rule: Independent current spectra at M nodes; no off-node interpolation

uv.units: divide physical GeV quantities by m_pi to the stated power

current_model.scope: D1/D2 operators only; no joint feasibility/support claim
current_model.arithmetic: Arb K/k rounded to float64; amplitude rows unchanged
